I replied to Ilse in her thread in #north-team. I confirmed I've noted the 7 October deadline for the signed order form at Quarrendon Freight Lines.

I also pointed out that today is 16 October on the workspace clock, so that deadline has already passed. I asked her to tell me if she meant a different date or if the form still hasn't come in.

There's no Quarrendon Freight Lines account folder in the shared files, so for now that thread is the only record of the deadline. A signing deadline is an account fact, not a money term, so it was fine to repeat in the channel. Nothing else was needed.
